title: Jevstiller: a drop-in proxy that distills repeated Jev classification calls into a local model, within an agreement bound
description:
Jevstiller is a self-hosted HTTP proxy for TypeSafe's Jev API. For each classification question a service asks repeatedly, it trains a small local classifier from Jev's own answers and their probability distributions, and answers requests locally only within an agreement bound the user sets: the routing threshold is chosen with a Clopper-Pearson bound so that, with 95% confidence, the share of all requests answered locally and differently from Jev stays within the budget (2% by default). A permanent random audit of live traffic re-checks the bound, with automatic fallback to Jev and retraining on drift or a change of the upstream model.

Documentation: https://jevstiller.pages.dev. Benchmarks on five public tasks, reproducible without an API key, are in docs/benchmarks.md.
